performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; purchase clustering masks a near-zero baseline run.

findings.text: ROAS fell 63.24% week-over-week to 3.56; last 3 days (Aug 19–21) show 2 purchases vs 3 prior 3 days (Aug 16–18, 6 purchases) — decline accelerating.
Purchase pattern is extreme clustering: 6 on Aug 11, 3 on Aug 17, 0 on 8 of last 10 days — no sustainable conversion rhythm at ~$54/day spend.
Overdue: Live-Cooking Shoot 1 was due Aug 14 with no completed event recorded — fresh creative pipeline is stalled at a moment when fatigue is driving ROAS down.
IG reach fell 15.04% week-over-week and trended from ~1,095 (Jul 25) to 593–605 (Aug 19–21) — a 45% organic reach decay over 4 weeks with spend flat.
GBP actions hit 0 on Aug 20–21 vs a 45-day average of ~17/day — either a data dropout or a sudden local-intent cliff that warrants immediate verification.

suggestions.text: Inject real-footage creatives (Haney's Jul 21 facility footage) into BWS - Sales - Muslims; replace at least 2 ad sets within 5 days.
suggestions.monday_update: The top campaign BWS - Sales - Muslims ($856.59 of $1,509.44 28d spend) is showing a 63.24% ROAS drop and purchases clustered on only 2 of the last 10 days, consistent with creative fatigue compounded by the stalled Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (overdue Aug 14). Action: pull Haney's real facility footage from the Jul 21 Drive folder and launch at least 2 fresh ad variants into the existing campaign structure within 5 days. Success check: 3-day purchase average rises above 1.0/day and ROAS recovers above 4.0 by Aug 30. Sohib to confirm footage availability with Haney before Nacer schedules the edit.

suggestions.text: Verify GBP listing health immediately — 0 actions on Aug 20–21 vs 17/day average may signal a listing suspension or data break.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to zero on Aug 20 and Aug 21 against a 45-day average of approximately 17 actions/day. This is either a platform data gap or an active listing issue (suspension, ownership conflict, or category change). Action: log into the Google Business Profile dashboard today and confirm listing status, check for any policy flags, and cross-reference Aug 20–21 call and direction counts manually. Success check: actions resume at ≥10/day within 48 hours, or root cause is identified and escalated. Report back to Nacer by Aug 24.

suggestions.text: Hold spend flat at ~$54/day; do not scale BWS - Sales - Muslims until new creative is live and 3-day purchase average is confirmed above 1.0/day.
suggestions.monday_update: With ROAS at 3.56 and falling 63.24% week-over-week, and purchases appearing on only 2 of the last 10 days, scaling now would deepen the loss. Current daily spend of ~$54/day is the floor; do not increase until the creative refresh (S1) is live and the 3-day purchase signal turns positive. Re-check on Aug 25: if purchases average ≥1.0/day over Aug 22–24, Sohib may approve a modest +15% daily budget increase on the best-performing ad set.
